segments.expected: It was six on Wednesday, and the loft was dark except for the candle on the sill by the north window, and the window was grey. Aske held the hand for two minutes by his watch, as he always did, and then for one more, and then he let it go and wrote. Warm at six on Wednesday the 16th. Three mornings. Thursday, if wanted, and the price said first. He looked at the line.

segments.expected: Perrin declared at the comb table at eight, in his flat clear voice, with his coat buttoned over the linen. "Team Seven. Rowan, Ember, declared, by her captain's voice. Finch, ward, catcher, for Cade. Pryce, ward. Talley, edge. Cade stands down, on his healer's card, and captains from the hard." A murmur went along the causeway. It was not the warm sound. It was the sound of people telling each other what they had heard. Ember. Not stance. Ember. Kiva heard somebody in green say what's she want an Ember for on a beach, and somebody else say they've no plant, they've got no plant at all.
